name: Carrier Global

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Logo of the Carrier Corporation.svg)

description: Carrier makes and services heating, cooling, ventilation and refrigeration equipment under Carrier, Viessmann, Toshiba, Automated Logic and Carrier Transicold, and sells related building services (audit, design, installation, repair, maintenance, monitoring). It reports four segments: Climate Solutions Americas (about 48 percent of 2025 sales), Europe, Asia Pacific/Middle East/Africa, and Transportation (transport refrigeration for trucks, trailers, containers and rail). Over 2024 it reshaped itself into a pure-play climate company: bought Viessmann Climate Solutions (January 2024) and sold Fire & Security, Access Solutions and Industrial Fire. It agreed in December 2025 to sell Riello (burners, boilers, heat pumps) to Ariston for about $430 million.

employees.note: About 47,000 employees in more than 52 countries; 34 percent in the Americas.

businessLines.name: Climate Solutions Americas
businessLines.how: Sells residential and commercial heating, cooling and ventilation equipment plus controls and aftermarket services in North and South America; one-time equipment sales with recurring service work on the installed base.

businessLines.name: Climate Solutions Europe
businessLines.how: Heating (Viessmann heat pumps and boilers) and cooling equipment and services in Europe; equipment sales with service.

businessLines.name: Climate Solutions Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa
businessLines.how: Residential and commercial HVAC equipment (including Toshiba) and services across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa; equipment sales plus services.

businessLines.name: Climate Solutions Transportation
businessLines.how: Sells transport refrigeration units and monitoring (Carrier Transicold) for trucks, trailers, shipping containers, intermodal and rail, plus aftermarket parts and service; tied to freight equipment orders.
